_comment: EXT-63, arm 31 — 3 h CANONICAL at the NEW 15/15 MASKS.  The re-established denominator.
WHY THIS RUN IS MANDATORY, not optional.  On 2026-08-05 the masks were unified by user
directive at the lineage root _ft63_24h_conv.json:
processing.elevation_mask_deg                       10 -> 15
estimation.ionosphere_weighting.elevation_cutoff_deg 25 -> 15
Every arm in SPEC_level_information_budget §9-§20 ran at 10/25.  Under invariant #6 a
shared-path posture change requires a same-build, same-posture golden comparison, so no
new arm can be graded until the canonical denominator exists at 15/15.  This is it.
WHAT IT TESTS (prediction stated before the run, SPEC §20.3): the ionosphere LEVEL
deficit gets WORSE.  Basis: the 25 deg iono cutoff was VALIDATED and SHIPPED because at
10 deg the 305-sta field diverged a00 296 -> -305 TECU with clock-delta rms 77x worse
(memory project_global_sh_iono).  Lowering the mask historically pushed a00 DOWN, and
DEFECT 2 is a00 too LOW.  15 deg re-admits the 15-25 deg elevation band into the SH
constraint, and the recorded path down (lever 2: carrier-smooth the code GF seed FIRST)
is NOT built -- the seed is still a per-epoch code GF estimate, ~0.26-0.37 m scatter.
Quantitative predictions against the SAME arm at 10/25 (runs/ext63_dual_12h_ref h0-3):
a00-GIM h0  was -15.83, h1 -8.20, h2 -3.89, h3 -3.81   -> predict MORE negative
postfit phase rms h2-3 was 0.00900 m                    -> predict roughly flat or
slightly BETTER (raising the OBS mask 10->15 drops the noisiest low-el observations,
which is the half of this change that should help the residuals)
sh_health was 0/0/0                                     -> at risk if a00 nears the
2 TECU band floor
Note the two edits push OPPOSITE ways and this arm cannot separate them: raising the obs
mask removes low-el multipath (helps), lowering the iono cutoff re-admits low-el code
contamination into a00 (hurts).  Separating them needs a 15/25 arm, which is the natural
follow-up if this one degrades.
The POSTURE CHECK will now WARN (it requires elevation_cutoff_deg >= 24.9,
GnssConfigNetworkPosture.cpp:369-373 and :553-565).  That warning is EXPECTED here and is
not evidence of a misconfiguration -- but do not silence it.
GRADE (CLAUDE.md amendment 6): scripts/gim_global_mean_series.py AND
scripts/field_vs_gim_footprint.py, time-matched, plus median postfit phase rms from
network_pf_keyed.csv STA rows over the settled 20-60 min window.  Per invariant #5 and
SPEC §17 item 0 the a00 number is a DIAGNOSTIC; the residual is the grade.
FRESH LINEAGE ONLY: own paths; never resume onto a 10/25 snapshot.
